alt: 女孩雙手捧著彩繪陶兔，花朵和釉色都很漂亮，卻有一隻耳尖缺了一小角；老師微笑伸指指出缺口，後方擺著其他陶器。
scene_prompt: 成語：採『整體很好，卻仍有一點小缺陷』，重點是大部分令人滿意，只剩局部遺憾。台灣國小陶藝展示桌，一位女孩滿意欣賞自己完成的精緻兔子陶作，釉色柔和、姿態可愛，唯獨一側耳朵尖端有小小缺角。老師站在旁邊，一手指向缺角，另一手自然垂下，神情肯定中帶些惋惜；女孩輕輕托住底座，望向那個唯一小缺點。缺角清楚可見但不影響作品站立，不畫全面破裂或完全失敗。只畫兩人，手指與作品不重疊，桌與雙腳接地。素牆無書脊，衣鞋全素色，無字無品牌。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist. Every person has five fingers per hand, arms clearly attached to shoulders, feet grounded and pointing naturally.
